about: Thursday-night run, tonight's game only (Buccaneers at Cowboys, 8:15 ET). Built with Wednesday's final injury report and today's book prices. The Sunday and Monday games aren't in this run yet. Players who are out are removed, and the next men up get their carries and targets in the numbers. The model's yardage projections run below the books' lines for many lead players, so the big under numbers say more about the model than about a sure thing.
